title: Permission and URL conventions
summary: Structure Wave 3 documents and enforces permission and URL conventions without renaming live grants or prefixes. Legacy Super Admin and pet-profiles paths become permanent 301 redirects.
changes: Document and enforce Core / Module / Plugin permission naming while keeping every existing admin.* and {module}.{plugin}.* string (no rename to core.*).
Group the Access permission catalogue by Core, Module, and Plugin, with grant-count reporting on myapes:authorization-check.
Add an id-preserving permission rename helper and grant reporter; the alias map stays empty so grants are unchanged.
Publish a LegacyRedirectTable for stable live prefixes and convert Super Admin, Access deep-links, and pet-profiles redirects to HTTP 301.
Keep placeholders for later plugin package route moves without changing live URIs.
affected_areas: Legacy Super Admin and pet-profiles redirects
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: Structure Wave 3 permission and URL conventions with zero permission renames and 301s only for already-moved legacy paths.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify / CI before merge; Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge.
known_limitations: Plugin controllers and models remain under App\Http and App\Models until later Structure waves move them into plugins/<slug>.
Module and plugin package route files are still placeholders; live URIs do not move in this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. No database migration runs in this release; rolling back application code restores the prior 302 redirect status codes and Access catalogue grouping.
provenance: Structure Wave 3 permission naming #292 and URL conventions #293 via pull request #306.
